verdict.rationale: Cloud Functions for Firebase runs backend code automatically in response to background events, HTTPS requests, or Cloud Scheduler jobs, and deploys with one CLI command. That covers the core of unattended background automation. However, these are developer-written code triggers, not AI-driven or agentic automations, and nothing shows the MCP server or Gemini in Firebase can create or run autonomous background tasks. Missing for 10: AI/agent-driven automation setup, evidence that the MCP server or Gemini can create or manage scheduled or triggered jobs, and independent hands-on corroboration of scheduled automations.
